metadata.title: Workforce Action Plan
metadata.preparedFor: Advancing Together, Black Hawk County Public Health, and workforce partner organizations
metadata.shortPurpose: Strengthen navigator capacity, workforce partner alignment, employer connection points, and wraparound support pathways.
metadata.purpose: This charter-style action plan guides Advancing Together, Black Hawk County Public Health, and partner organizations in implementing Economic Stability Strategies 9, 10, and 12. The work strengthens navigator and liaison capacity, connects employers and workforce agencies with community partners, and improves employment/resource connection points for residents facing language, cultural, logistical, credentialing, reentry, transportation, childcare, or other barriers to care and economic stability.
metadata.coalitionRole: Advancing Together convenes, aligns, supports, and tracks workforce access strategies while partner agencies lead implementation in their lanes.

sections.title: Charter, Landscape, and Role Clarity
sections.summary: Confirm roles, map current infrastructure, align with existing plans, and establish a practical community input process.

actions.title: Convene the workforce action team and confirm the coalition charter.
keyTasks: Schedule quarterly meetings
confirm that Strategies 9, 10, and 12 will be managed as a coordinated workforce access strategy
document lead, core team, and collaborator roles
define where Advancing Together will convene, align, support, and track
resources: shared agenda, minutes, and file space
successIndicators: Charter, meeting rhythm, role list, and first-year decision list are documented
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Create a landscape map of workforce meetings, navigators, programs, employer initiatives, and community-led efforts.
keyTasks: Inventory existing meetings, coalitions, programs, navigators, employer panels, job fairs, and community-led efforts
distinguish groups that should be connected from groups that should remain separate
note who primarily supports job seekers, employers, training, wraparound supports, or community leadership
successIndicators: Landscape map identifies current infrastructure, gaps, overlap, and practical connection points without assuming groups must merge
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Align the CHIP workforce work with Grow Cedar Valley, IowaWORKS, Hawkeye, LSI, and related strategic plans.
keyTasks: Review Grow Cedar Valley Count Me In/Population Study Big Bets and strategic plan direction
document where CHIP strategies can support existing workforce, education, economic mobility, and navigation priorities
identify decisions that should wait for partner plans
successIndicators: A one-page alignment memo names shared priorities, partner-owned work, and areas where Advancing Together can add value
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Set a practical process for community leaders to shape first-year workforce priorities.
responsibleParties: community leaders from groups experiencing employment barriers
keyTasks: Meet with immigrant/refugee, Black-led, reentry, and other community leaders to identify workforce barriers and priorities
determine how leaders will be invited, compensated when resources allow, and protected from unfunded expectations
successIndicators: Community input process is documented and at least two community-led priorities are reflected in the year 1 pilot selection criteria
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

sections.title: Navigation and Wraparound Connections
sections.summary: Strengthen navigator, liaison, training, and wraparound support pathways for people facing language, cultural, logistical, or credentialing barriers.

actions.title: Define the workforce navigation role within the LSI immigrant/refugee navigation pilot and related community-building work.
keyTasks: Meet with LSI and workforce partners
clarify how navigation can connect people to employment, training, English language learning, credential help, transportation, childcare, and other supports
identify referral handoffs that do not duplicate existing case management
successIndicators: Pilot design includes workforce referral pathways, partner contacts, and a short list of barriers that navigators can elevate
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Build a shared navigator and liaison contact list with warm handoff expectations.
keyTasks: Identify navigators, liaisons, adult education contacts, workforce staff, and wraparound support organizations
create basic warm handoff guidance
clarify when to refer for employment, training, childcare, transportation, documentation, housing, health, or legal support
resources: meeting time to test the process
successIndicators: At least 15 navigator or liaison contacts are documented and at least five organizations agree to use or test the handoff guidance
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Identify one occupation or sector where credentialing or bridge pathway barriers can be studied locally.
keyTasks: Review occupations where internationally trained workers, frontline workers, or people seeking advancement face credential barriers
consider childcare, health support, manufacturing, or other sectors with partner readiness
document pathway steps, costs, language needs, and employer interest
successIndicators: A pathway scan identifies one feasible sector for deeper pilot design and names barriers that require funding or policy support
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Test the navigator-to-workforce referral pathway with a small group of partners.
keyTasks: Use the shared contact list and referral guidance with a limited number of referrals or event participants
track common barriers, response time, follow-up needs, and where people fall out of the process
resources: interpretation and transportation support as available
successIndicators: Pilot partners document referrals, common barriers, and at least three process improvements for broader use
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q7: Jan-Mar 2028.

sections.title: Employer, Training, and Event Alignment
sections.summary: Use existing employer relationships and workforce events to improve connections to jobs, training, mentorship, advancement, and practical supports.

actions.title: Engage a small employer learning group on practical hiring, onboarding, retention, and advancement barriers.
keyTasks: Use existing employer conversations, panels, and Grow Cedar Valley relationships to identify employers willing to learn about language, cultural, logistical, reentry, childcare, transportation, and advancement barriers
gather concrete practice changes employers are willing to test
resources: examples from Tent Partnership, Switchboard, and local employers
successIndicators: At least six employers participate in a learning discussion and at least three identify a practical change or pilot idea
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Select one or two existing job fairs, resource fairs, panels, or employer meetings to strengthen rather than create a new event.
keyTasks: Review existing events and employer meetings
select events where wraparound supports, trusted community partners, interpretation, transportation information, childcare information, training options, or mentorship connections can be added
resources: interpretation and translated materials if needed
possible transportation or childcare support information
successIndicators: One or two existing events are selected with agreed improvements, partner roles, and success measures
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Redesign selected workforce events to include wraparound supports and trusted community partners.
keyTasks: Add resource tables or referral connections for training, English language learning, childcare, transportation, reentry support, documentation help, and other barriers to care and employment
include community partners in planning and outreach
resources: incentives or transportation support if available
successIndicators: At least one improved event is held or fully planned, and participant/partner feedback identifies what made the event more useful
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027 - Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Draft a local employer practice checklist for recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and advancing workers facing barriers.
keyTasks: Adapt promising practices into a simple checklist or conversation guide
include language access, supervisor communication, scheduling, mentorship, credential pathways, HR paperwork, digital systems, and advancement supports
test with employers before wider use
successIndicators: Draft checklist is tested with at least three employers and revised based on employer and community partner feedback
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q7: Jan-Mar 2028.

actions.title: Connect workforce events and employer meetings to training, mentorship, and advancement pathways.
keyTasks: Use event and employer feedback to identify follow-up pathways into adult education, work-based learning, apprenticeships, mentoring, entrepreneurship support, reentry employment support, or advancement conversations
document next steps for people not currently reached
successIndicators: At least two follow-up pathways are documented and partners can describe how participants move from events to next-step supports
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q6: Oct-Dec 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

sections.title: Pilot Testing, Evaluation, and Sustainability
sections.summary: Select small pilots, pursue feasible funding, track progress, and decide what should continue beyond 2028.

actions.title: Choose one employer-facing and one community-facing pilot for implementation or funding development.
keyTasks: Use landscape findings, community input, and partner readiness to select small pilots
possible options include LSI workforce navigation add-on, employer onboarding practice test, credential pathway scan, childcare workforce pathway, or redesigned job/resource fair
successIndicators: Two pilot concepts are selected with lead partners, scope, budget needs, and measures
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027 - Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Develop funding and capacity support for selected workforce pilots and community participation.
keyTasks: Identify funding needs for staff time, community leadership participation, interpretation, transportation information, materials, evaluation, incentives, and technology
align requests with broader Economic Stability funding work
support partner-led proposals where appropriate
successIndicators: At least one pilot has a realistic funding path or partner commitment, and community participation costs are included where feasible
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Track quarterly implementation measures across navigation, employer engagement, events, and pilots.
keyTasks: Collect simple quarterly measures, including partners participating, navigators connected, employers engaged, events improved, community members connected to training or supports, barriers identified, and pilot lessons
review data during quarterly meetings
successIndicators: Quarterly updates are shared with Advancing Together and used to adjust actions, funding requests, and partner follow-up
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.

actions.title: Decide which workforce practices should be sustained, scaled, adapted, or stopped after pilot testing.
keyTasks: Review pilot results, partner capacity, employer feedback, community priorities, funding status, and fit with existing plans
identify owners for sustained practices and what should move into routine workforce or coalition operations
successIndicators: Sustainability decision memo names practices to continue, adapt, scale, or stop, with owners and resource needs beyond December 2028
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q8: Apr-Jun 2028 - Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.

actions.title: Complete the 2028 workforce strategy review and next-cycle recommendations.
keyTasks: Summarize what was built, what was tested, who was reached, what barriers remain, how the work affected areas with higher burden, and what should be embedded in the next CHIP or partner strategic plans
successIndicators: Final review includes outcomes, lessons, owners, resource needs, and recommendations for 2029 and beyond
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Workforce source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.
